title: One step of the folding simulation
statement: Let $\Gamma$ be a finite alphabet with decidable equality, let $M$ be a finite Turing machine over $\Gamma$, let $x$ be an input word over $\Gamma$, and let $c$ be a configuration of $M$ on $x$. One step of the folding simulator of $M$ from the folded configuration of $c$ equals the folded configuration of the result of one step of $M$ from $c$.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ is a finite Turing machine over $\Gamma$
replaced:
Let $M$ be a multi-tape machine over a finite alphabet $\Gamma$ with decidable
equality and let $c$ be a configuration of $M$ on an input $x$ over $\Gamma$.  One
step of the folding simulator of $M$ on the folded configuration of $c$ equals the
folded configuration of one step of $M$ on $c$.
